plans.title: Projects
plans.subtitle: Work with an outcome and a date: lead, teams, milestones, progress and updates.
plans.emptyBody: A project groups the issues behind one outcome, like a launch. Give it a lead and a target date, and post updates as it moves.
plans.linearNote: Works like Projects in Linear: issues from one or more teams behind one outcome.
plans.summaryPlaceholder: One line on what this project delivers

plan.remindersHelp: While the project is in progress, Track reminds the lead in their Inbox at 9:00 on this day.
plan.deleteBody: The project, its milestones and updates are deleted. Its issues stay in their teams.
plan.notFound: This project does not exist or you cannot see it.
plan.invalidRange: The target date has to be on or after the start date.
plan.descriptionEmpty: No description yet. Add the goal, scope and links the team needs.
plan.descriptionPlaceholder: Goal, scope, open questions. Markdown works.
plan.milestonesEmpty: No milestones yet. Add checkpoints with a date and assign issues to them.
plan.noTeams: Add a team to this project to create issues here.
plan.searchIssues: Add issues: search by title or ID
plan.noIssuesBody: Create an issue above or search for existing ones to add them.

updates.bodyPlaceholder: What moved, what is blocked, what comes next
updates.notifyHelp: The lead, members and followers get it in their Inbox.
updates.emptyBody: Post the first update with its health so everyone knows where this project stands.

events.startDate: {actor} moved the start date from {from} to {to}
events.targetDate: {actor} moved the target date from {from} to {to}

initiatives.title: Initiatives
initiatives.subtitle: Group projects under a company goal and follow their health together.
initiatives.emptyBody: An initiative groups projects behind one goal, with an owner and a target date. Its progress adds up the progress of its projects.
initiatives.noPlans: No projects yet. Add an existing project or create one.
initiatives.deleteBody: Its projects stay. Sub-initiatives move up a level.
initiatives.notFound: This initiative does not exist or you cannot see it.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Projects and initiatives on a timeline, from start to target date.
roadmap.dragHint: Drag a bar to move its dates, or drag an edge to change the start or target date. With a bar focused, use the arrow keys.
roadmap.unscheduledHelp: Set a target date to place it on the roadmap.
roadmap.emptyBody: Projects with a target date show up here as bars you can drag.
roadmap.updateError: Could not change the dates. Try again.

cycles.title: Cycles
cycles.subtitle: Every team's cycles with their scope, progress, velocity and capacity.
cycles.emptyBody: Cycles are set per team. Turn on automatic cycles or create one from a team's settings.
cycles.notFound: This cycle does not exist or you cannot see it.
cycles.carriedHint: Moved to the next cycle when this one closed
cycles.velocityHint: Average done in the last {count, plural, one {# cycle} other {# cycles}}
cycles.overCapacity: More than the team usually finishes
cycles.underCapacity: Within what the team usually finishes
cycles.notStarted: This cycle has not started yet.
cycles.rolloverHelp: When a cycle ends, what is not done moves to the next cycle on its own, once a day.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Measure your issues: count, effort, cycle time and lead time, sliced by status, assignee, label, project or team.
insights.label: Label
insights.timeNote: Time measures show the median in days and are not segmented. Cycle time runs from the first move to in progress until done; lead time from creation until done.
insights.emptyBody: Change the filters or the measure to see data.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.subtitle: Saved insights side by side, for the whole team or just for you.
dashboards.emptyBody: Build an insight and add it to a dashboard, or start an empty one.
dashboards.visibilityHelp: Workspace dashboards are visible to every member. Personal ones only to you.
dashboards.noWidgetsBody: Open Insights, build a chart and use Add to dashboard.
dashboards.notFound: This dashboard does not exist or you cannot see it.

automation.title: Auto-close and auto-archive
automation.help: Per team, like Linear's team settings. Runs once a day.
automation.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can change these settings.
automation.autoCloseHelp: Backlog and todo issues with no changes in this time move to a canceled status. Issues in a current cycle or an active project are left alone. Subscribers get notified.
automation.staleCount: {count, plural, =0 {No issues would close today.} one {# issue would close today.} other {# issues would close today.}}
automation.autoArchiveHelp: Done and canceled issues with no changes in this time leave the lists. You can restore them below.
automation.cyclesHelp: Cycles that ended close on their own and move unfinished issues to the next cycle.
automation.restored: {count, plural, one {# issue restored} other {# issues restored}}
